user.title: AITO Login
user.description: Use a Huawei account with AITO vehicle service access. The first setup requires an SMS verification code. The integration encrypts and stores the account password and a stable device identity locally to maintain the session. A dedicated Home Assistant account is recommended because signing in to the AITO app or another device with the same account may require the integration to authenticate again.

sms.title: SMS Verification
sms.description: Enter the SMS verification code sent to this Huawei account phone number. The code is used only to verify this first sign-in.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to AITO service. Please try again later.
error.invalid_auth: Huawei account authentication failed. Check the phone number, password, and SMS verification code.
error.no_vehicles: Login succeeded, but no vehicles were returned for this account.
